chapter: The Dallas nightclub and Jesse Stone's band
title: Rehearsing in St. Joseph; George E. Lee hears the band
summary: The stranded band rehearses daily; George E. Lee hears them at the Frog Hop Ballroom and is scared by their arrangements.

bands.name: Jesse Stone and His Blue Serenaders

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: But I mean and some of the cats used to lay in bed all day rather than to give it up. So we were stranded. We used to rehearse every day. We had a great, great band, and I think I -- it was mentioned that this was when I first met Georgie Lee. He used to come in there, and they had opened up a great million-dollar ballroom called the Frog Hop Ballroom, and Georgie Lee heard them, and when he heard our band it
scared him to death, because they had never heard nothing like this, and we had music arrangements -- Eddie Durham was writing. I -- this is when I first started to learn how to write.
